Items.Question: Describe a memorable journey you have taken.
Items.ModelAnswer: I'd like to talk about a trip I took to Ha Long Bay two years ago. It was a three-day cruise with my family. What made it unforgettable was the stunning limestone karsts rising from the emerald water. We went kayaking through hidden caves, and at night, the sky was full of stars — no light pollution at all. The fresh seafood was incredible too. This journey reminded me how beautiful Vietnam's natural landscapes are.

Items.Vocabulary: limestone karsts (tháp vôi), emerald water (nước ngọc bích), light pollution (ô nhiễm ánh sáng), unforgettable (đ难忘)
Items.Tips: Part 2 cần nói 1-2 phút. Dùng cấu trúc: Introduction -> Details -> Feelings/Reflection. Nhấn mạnh từ khóa: unforgettable, stunning, reminded me.

Items.Question: Describe a person who has influenced you.
Items.ModelAnswer: The person who has influenced me most is my high school English teacher, Ms. Lan. She didn't just teach grammar — she taught us to think critically and express ourselves confidently. I remember how she encouraged me to join the debate club despite my shyness. Her belief in me changed my trajectory. Today, I still use the communication skills she nurtured in every presentation at work.

Items.Tips: Dùng quá khứ đơn cho câu chuyện, hiện tại hoàn thành cho tác động kéo dài. Cấu trúc: Who -> What they did -> Impact -> Present relevance.
